oromo: FIFA gabaasa Prezidaantiin FIFA Giyaanii Infantinoo karoorri gurgurtaa mirga daldalaa Waancaa Addunyaa erga fashaleen booda mootummaa Traampii irraa deeggarsa gaafatan jedhu dhugaa miti jedhee haaleera. FIFA gabaasichi hiikaa tokko kan hin qabneefi soba akka ta'e ibseera. Kanneen keessatti Infantinoo hoggansa isaa fi egeree isaa ilaalchisee hiriyoota kubbaa miillaa fi qaamolee dhimmi kun isaan ilaallatu irraa komii cimaa mudachaa jira.

title: Why are oil companies posting record profits amid Iran war disruption?
english: Global energy markets are experiencing significant instability due to the closure of the Strait of Hormuz during the ongoing conflict with Iran. This disruption has caused oil prices to spike worldwide, leading major corporations like ExxonMobil, Chevron, and Shell to report record-breaking quarterly profits. While the war creates economic hardship for consumers, these companies are benefiting from the surging market costs and expanded profit margins.
amharic: ከኢራን ጋር በተፈጠረው ግጭት ምክንያት የሆርሙዝ ባህረ ሰላጤ በመዘጋቱ በአለም አቀፍ የነዳጅ ገበያ ላይ ከፍተኛ መስተጓጎል ተፈጥሯል። ይህም የነዳጅ ዋጋ በአለም አቀፍ ደረጃ እንዲጨምር በማድረጉ፣ እንደ ኤክሰን ሞቢል፣ ሼቭሮን እና ሼል ያሉ ትላልቅ የነዳጅ ኩባንያዎች ከፍተኛ የትርፍ መጠን እንዲያመዘግቡ አድርጓቸዋል። ጦርነቱ በህዝብ ላይ ኢኮኖሚያዊ ጫና እየፈጠረ ቢሆንም፣ እነዚህ ኩባንያዎች ግን ከነዳጅ ዋጋ ንረት ከፍተኛ ትርፍ እያገኙ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Waraana Iran waliin walqabatee cufamuu daandii galaana Hormuz irraa kan ka'e, gabaan boba'aa addunyaa jeeqamee jira. Kunis gatiin boba'aa addunyaa maratti akka dabalu waan taasiseef, dhaabbileen boba'aa gurguddoon akka ExxonMobil, Chevron fi Shell bu'aa baasii isaanii keessatti rikardii cabsuu danda'aniiru. Waraanichi lammiilee irratti rakkoo dinagdee kan uumu ta'us, dhaabbileen kunneen garuu gatiin boba'aa dabaluu isaa irraa fayyadamaa jiru.

title: Spanish PM Sanchez faces criticism as EU meets over Ceuta crossings
english: Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez is under pressure from European leaders following a massive and tragic migration surge into the Spanish territory of Ceuta. While most of the 60,000 individuals who entered have returned to Morocco, the incident has reignited deep divisions within the EU regarding how to manage external borders and humanitarian responsibilities. Italy has notably criticized Spain's response, though Prime Minister Sanchez defended his government by pointing to broader migration trends across the bloc.
amharic: የስፔኑ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ፔድሮ ሳንቼዝ በስፔን ግዛት ሴኡታ ውስጥ በተከሰተው ከፍተኛ የስደተኞች መጉረፍ ሳቢያ ከአውሮፓውያን መሪዎች ትችት እየቀረበባቸው ነው። ወደ ስፔን ከገቡት 60,000 ሰዎች መካከል አብዛኞቹ ወደ ሞሮኮ የተመለሱ ቢሆንም፣ ይህ ክስተት በአውሮፓ ህብረት ውስጥ የድንበር ደህንነትን እና የሰብአዊ መብት ግዴታዎችን በተመለከተ ያለውን ልዩነት አባብሶታል። የጣሊያን መንግስት የስፔንን አያያዝ በመተቸቱ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ሳንቼዝ የሃገራቸውን ድርጊት በመከላከል ምላሽ ሰጥተዋል።
oromo: Mummichi ministeeraa Ispeen Pedro Sanchez erga namoonni 60,000 ol ta'an naannoo Ceuta seenanii booda mormii fi qeeqa gaggeessitoota Awurooppaa irraa isa mudachaa jira. Namoonni hedduun gara Morookootti deebi'anis, raawwiin kun rakkoo daangaa fi mirga namummaa irratti biyyoota Gamtaa Awurooppaa gidduutti wal dhabdee uumee jira. Mootummaan Xaaliyaanii tarkaanfii mootummaan Ispeen fudhate kan qeeqe yoo ta'u, Mummichi ministeeraa Sanchez ammoo qeeqa kana mormuun hojii mootummaa isaa irra deebi'ee ibseera.

title: Labour Friends of Israel defends major West Bank settlement blocs
english: The Labour Friends of Israel (LFI) lobby group has released a report arguing against a potential British government ban on products from Israeli settlements in the West Bank. While the International Court of Justice considers all these settlements illegal, the LFI report suggests that major settlement blocs should be treated differently and that a total trade boycott is impractical. This position challenges the current government's consideration of stricter measures against settlement imports in response to ongoing regional violence.
amharic: የሌበር ፍሬንድስ ኦፍ እስራኤል (LFI) ቡድን በዌስት ባንክ በሚገኙ የእስራኤል ሰፈራዎች ላይ የብሪታንያ መንግስት የንግድ እገዳ እንዳይጥል የሚጠይቅ ሪፖርት አውጥቷል። ምንም እንኳን ዓለም አቀፍ ፍርድ ቤት እነዚህ ሰፈራዎች በሙሉ ህገ-ወጥ እንደሆኑ ቢገልጽም፣ የLFI ሪፖርት ዋና ዋናዎቹን የሰፈራ ማዕከላት እንደ ልዩ ጉዳይ በመመልከት አጠቃላይ የንግድ እገዳው ተገቢ እንዳልሆነ ይከራከራል። ይህ አቋም መንግስት በክልሉ እየተባባሰ የመጣውን ግጭት ለመግታት ከሚወስዳቸው እርምጃዎች ጋር የተያያዘ ነው።
oromo: Gareen 'Labour Friends of Israel' (LFI) jedhamu, mootummaan Britaniyaa meeshaalee naannoo West Bank keessa jiran kan qubata Israa'elootaa irraa dhufan akka hin dhowwine gabaasa baasee jira. Manneen murtii idil-addunyaa qubatni kunneen hundi seeraan alaa dha jedhanii yoo amananiyyi, gabaasni LFI garuu ganda gurguddaa ta'an adda baasanii ilaaluun fi daldala guututti dhowwuun akka hin danda'amne ni dubbata. Yaanni kunis, mootummaan ammaa naannichatti jeequmsa jiru sababeeffachuun meeshaalee qubata san irraa dhufan irratti tarkaanfii cimaa fudhachuuf karoorfatuuf mormii ta'eera.

title: Afternoon update
english: The United States and Iran are engaged in discussions regarding the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz, with US officials expressing optimism that an agreement could be reached soon despite Iran's lack of formal confirmation. While tensions remain high, the potential for a diplomatic resolution has already caused global oil prices to drop. Meanwhile, Lebanon and Israel have begun a new round of direct negotiations in Rome despite domestic criticism from Hezbollah.
amharic: አሜሪካ እና ኢራን በሆርሙዝ የባህር ወሽመጥ ዳግም መከፈት ዙሪያ ድርድር እያደረጉ ሲሆን፣ የአሜሪካ ባለስልጣናት ስምምነት ላይ ለመድረስ ያላቸውን ተስፋ ገልጸዋል። በኢራን በኩል ይፋዊ ማረጋገጫ ባይሰጥም፣ የድርድሩ መጀመር የነዳጅ ዋጋ እንዲቀንስ አድርጓል። በተመሳሳይ ሁኔታ ሊባኖስ እና እስራኤል በሮም ቀጥተኛ ውይይት መጀመራቸው ተሰምቷል።
oromo: Ameerikaan fi Iraan walta'iinsa daandii galaana Hormuz deebisanii banuuf marii gochaa jiru, ta'us Iraan ammaaf of eeggannoodhaan dubbachaa jirti. Mariin kun abdii uumee waan jiruuf gatiin boba'aa addunyaa irratti gadi bu'eera. Gama biraatiin, biyyoonni Libaanoos fi Israa'el marii kallattii ta'e tokko Room keessatti eegalaniiru.

title: Has the UAE's meteoric rise reached its limit?
english: Over the past two decades, the United Arab Emirates has transformed from a quiet Gulf state into a powerful regional influence by leveraging its wealth, military strength, and diplomatic partnerships. This rise was largely fueled by the country's ability to navigate regional power vacuums created by major Middle Eastern conflicts and shifting global alliances. However, as the geopolitical landscape evolves, experts are now questioning whether the UAE can sustain its assertive foreign policy in the long term.
amharic: ባለፉት ሁለት አስርት ዓመታት ውስጥ የተባበሩት አረብ ኤሚሬቶች ባላት የገንዘብ ሀብት፣ ወታደራዊ አቅም እና ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ግንኙነቶች በመጠቀም ከጸጥተኛ የባህረ ሰላጤ አገር ወደ ክልላዊ ተጽዕኖ ፈጣሪ ኃይልነት አድጋለች። ይህ እድገት የተመቻቸው በክልሉ በተከሰቱ ግጭቶች እና በትልልቅ አገራት መካከል በተፈጠሩ ክፍተቶች በመጠቀም ነው። ይሁን እንጂ፣ በአሁኑ ወቅት እየተለዋወጠ ባለው የፖለቲካ ሁኔታ ምክንያት ኤሚሬቶች ይህንን ተጽዕኖ ፈጣሪ የውጭ ፖሊሲዋን ለረጅም ጊዜ ማስቀጠል ትችል እንደሆነ ጥያቄዎች እየተነሱ ነው።
oromo: Ganna darban keessatti, biyyi Emireetota Gamtoomanii (UAE) qabeenya, humna waraanaa fi hariiroo dippilomaasii fayyadamuudhaan biyya nagaa turee gara biyya dhiibbaa guddaa qabduutti jijjiiramteetti. Guddinnii kunis, rakkoolee naannichaa keessatti uumaman fayyadamuu fi duwwaalee siyaasaa addunyaa iratti mul'atan guutuudhaan danda'ameera. Haa ta'u malee, yeroo ammaa haalli siyaasaa addunyaa jijjiiramaa waan jiruuf, Emireetonni siyaasa alaa ishee kana fuuldurattis itti fufsiisuu dandeessi moo hin dandeessu kan jedhu irratti shakkiiwwan jiru.

title: Marco Rubio says progress has been made in talks with Iran
english: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio announced that negotiations with Iran are advancing, although a formal resolution has not been reached. He expressed optimism that an agreement could be finalized in the near future. Meanwhile, President Donald Trump has issued a stern warning, stating that this represents Iran's final opportunity to settle the dispute before facing severe consequences.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ማርኮ ሩቢዮ ከኢራን ጋር እየተደረጉ ባሉ ድርድሮች ላይ መሻሻሎች ቢኖሩም እስካሁን የመጨረሻ ስምምነት ላይ አለመደረሱን አስታውቀዋል። ድርድሩ በቅርቡ እንደሚጠናቀቅ ተስፋ እንዳላቸውም ገልጸዋል። በሌላ በኩል ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ይህ ለኢራን የመጨረሻው የድርድር ዕድል እንደሆነ እና ስምምነት ላይ ካልደረሱ ከባድ እርምጃ እንደሚወሰድባቸው አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Ameerikaa Maarkoo Ruubiyooon marii biyyattii fi Iraan gidduutti godhamaa jiru irratti guddinni jiruus, hanga ammaatti waliigalteen xumuraa akka hin irra ga’amin ibsaniiru. Dhiheenya kana waliigaltee irra gahuuf abdii qabaachuu isaanii dubbataniiru. Gama biraatiin, Preezidaant Doonaald Traamp Iraan dhimma kana irratti waliigaltee irra gahuuf carraan isheen qabdu inni dhumaa akka ta’e fi osoo hin milkaa’in hafte tarkaanfii cimaan kan fudhatamu ta’uu akeekkachiisaniiru.

title: Oil prices fall amid hopes of US-Iran deal
english: Global oil prices dropped significantly following reports that the United States and Iran have restarted negotiations. Officials suggested that a diplomatic agreement might be reached very soon, which helped calm fears regarding potential energy supply issues. Consequently, stock markets showed positive growth, with major US indexes recording notable gains.
amharic: በአሜሪካ እና በኢራን መካከል ድርድር እንደገና መጀመሩን ተከትሎ የአለም የነዳጅ ዋጋ በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ ቀንሷል። የሁለቱ ሀገራት ስምምነት በቅርቡ ሊፈጸም እንደሚችል መገለጹ የነዳጅ አቅርቦት መስተጓጎል ስጋትን በማቀዝቀዙ የዋጋ መውረዱን አስከትሏል። ይህ ሁኔታ የአሜሪካ የአክሲዮን ገበያ ላይ አዎንታዊ ተጽዕኖ በመፍጠር አክሲዮኖች ዋጋ እንዲጨምሩ አድርጓል።
oromo: Hirmaannaan marii biyyoota Ameerikaa fi Iraan gidduutti jalqabamuun isaa gatiin boba'aa addunyaa akka hir'atu godheera. Walii galteen biyyoota lamaanii dhihoo keessatti akka milkaa'u dubbatamuun isaa, dhiyeessiin boba'aa adda cita jedhamee sodaatamaa ture akka tasgabbaa'u gargaareera. Haalli kun gabaa aksiyoonaa Ameerikaa irratti dhiibbaa gaarii uumee, gatiin aksiyoonotaa akka ol ka'u taasiseera.

title: Twelve years after ISIL’s massacres, thousands of Yazidis seek justice
english: The Yazidi community in Iraq is commemorating the twelfth anniversary of the 2014 ISIL attacks on Sinjar, an event officially classified by the UN as a genocide. Despite the passage of time, thousands of survivors are still displaced from their homes or remain unaccounted for. The community continues to call for international support to achieve justice and facilitate their safe return.
amharic: የኢራቅ የያዚዲ ማህበረሰብ በሲንጃር ላይ የተፈጸመው የISIS ጥቃት 12ኛ ዓመት መታሰቢያን እያከበሩ ነው። የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት የዘር ማጥፋት ወንጀል ብሎ በፈረጀው በዚህ ጥቃት የተረፉ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች አሁንም ከመኖሪያ ቀያቸው ተፈናቅለዋል ወይም የት እንዳሉ አይታወቅም። ማህበረሰቡ ፍትህ ለማግኘት እና ወደ ቀያቸው ለመመለስ የሚያስችል አለም አቀፍ ድጋፍ እንዲደረግላቸው እየጠየቁ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Hawaasni Yazidii Iraaq keessa jiraatan, haleellaa bara 2014 gareen ISIL magaala Sinjaar irratti raawwateen waggaa 12 guutuu isaanii yaadachaa jiru. Gamtaan Mootummootaa haleellaa kana fixiinsa sanyii jechuun beekamtii kenneefii jira. Hanga ammaatti, namoonni kumaatamaan lakkaa'aman qe'ee isaanii irraa buqqa'anii jiru ykn bakka buutee isaanii hin beekamu; hawaasichis haqni akka argamuufi gara mana isaanii akka deebi'an gargaarsa addunyaa gaafachaa jira.

title: More than 150 people rescued in English Channel after boat catches fire
english: A major rescue operation involving British and French authorities successfully saved over 150 migrants after their boat caught fire in the English Channel. The group had previously refused assistance during their journey before the vessel's engine malfunctioned, forcing many to jump into the water. This incident highlights the ongoing political tensions in the UK regarding small boat crossings and asylum policies.
amharic: በእንግሊዝ ቻናል ውስጥ በነበረ ጀልባ ላይ የእሳት አደጋ በመከሰቱ ምክንያት ከ150 በላይ ስደተኞች በእንግሊዝ እና በፈረንሳይ ባለስልጣናት የተቀናጀ ጥረት ታድገዋል። ስደተኞቹ ጉዟቸውን ከመቀጠላቸው በፊት እርዳታ ለመቀበል ፈቃደኛ አልነበሩም፣ ነገር ግን የጀልባው ሞተር በእሳት በመያዙ ምክንያት ብዙዎች ወደ ባህር ለመዝለል ተገደዋል። ይህ አደጋ በእንግሊዝ ውስጥ በትንንሽ ጀልባዎች የሚደረጉ ጉዞዎችን እና የስደተኞች መብትን በተመለከተ ያለውን የፖለቲካ ውዝግብ ጎላ አድርጎ አሳይቷል።
oromo: Dooniin baqattoota 150 ol baattee gara Ingiliz imalaa turte ibiddi qabachuu ishee hordofee, humnoonni fayyisaa kan Ingilizii fi Faransaay waliin ta’uun lubbuu isaanii oolchaniiru. Namoonni kunneen osoo dooniin sun hin boba’in dura gargaarsa didanii turan, garuu erga injiniin doonichaa boba’ee booda gara galaanichaa utaluuf dirqamaniiru. Ta’iin kun dhimma godaantotaa fi imaammata baqattootaa irratti biyya Ingiliz keessatti falmii siyaasaa cimaa kaaseera.

title: Six years after Beirut blast, families fight for truth
english: Six years after a massive explosion at the Beirut port caused by improperly stored chemicals, grieving families are still demanding justice and accountability from the government. The 2020 blast killed over 200 people and devastated the city, leaving a lasting scar on the community. Despite the passage of time, survivors and relatives of the victims remain united in their fight to ensure those responsible for the tragedy are held accountable.
amharic: እ.ኤ.አ በ2020 በቤሩት ወደብ በተከማቹ ኬሚካሎች ሳቢያ በደረሰው ታላቅ ፍንዳታ ስድስት ዓመታት ካለፉ በኋላ፣ የተጎጂ ቤተሰቦች አሁንም ፍትህን እና ተጠያቂነትን በመጠየቅ ላይ ናቸው። የከተማዋን ክፍሎች ያወደመው እና ከ200 በላይ ሰዎችን የገደለው ይህ አሳዛኝ ክስተት በህዝቡ ልብ ላይ ጥልቅ ጠባሳ ጥሎ አልፏል። ጊዜው ቢረዝምም፣ የተጎጂዎች ቤተሰቦች ለዚህ ጥፋት ተጠያቂ የሆኑ አካላት በህግ እንዲጠየቁ ያላቸውን ጽኑ አቋም በመቀጠል ላይ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Bara 2020 buufata doonii Beeyirutitti keemikaala sirritti hin qabamin irraa kan ka'e dhohiinsa guddaa erga mudatee waggaa jahaan boodas, maatiin miidhaan irra ga'e ammas haqaa fi itti gaafatamummaa gaafachaa jiru. Balaan kun namoota 200 ol ajjeesee fi magaalaa sana kan barbadeesse yoo ta'u, uummata irratti madaa guddaa hambiseera. Yeroon darbus, maatiin miidhamtootaa fi du'aa jiraattoonni, namoonni balaa kanaaf itti gaafatamummaa qaban seeratti akka dhiyaatan falmii isaanii cimsanii itti fufanii jiru.

title: Seventh round of Israel-Lebanon talks begins – what’s on the agenda?
english: A seventh round of US-mediated diplomatic talks has commenced in Rome, involving senior political and military officials from Israel and Lebanon. The primary goal of these discussions is to establish pilot zones that would allow for an Israeli military withdrawal and a handover of security control to the Lebanese army. Despite a previous ceasefire agreement, conflict has persisted, and negotiators are now working to secure a lasting resolution to the ongoing hostilities.

oromo: Hirmaannaan marii nageenyaa lammaffaa kan Itoophiyaa giddu-galeessa taasifate kun, Itoophiyaa fi Liibaanoos gidduutti Roomaatti eegaleera. Waliigalteen dhaabbii waraanaa kanaan dura godhame haala barbaadame irra gahuu baatus, gamtaan marii kun rakkoo jiru furuun nageenya waaraa fiduuf carraaqqii gochaa jiru.

title: Can Pakistan keep US-Iran diplomacy alive as mistrust deepens?
english: Pakistan is stepping up its diplomatic efforts to revive talks between Iran and the United States amid growing tensions and failed ceasefires. Pakistani officials have invited high-ranking Iranian representatives to Islamabad to explore a peaceful path forward. Despite recent threats from President Trump and denials of direct engagement from Tehran, Pakistan remains committed to its role as a key mediator to help resolve the ongoing conflict.
amharic: በኢራን እና በአሜሪካ መካከል ያለው ውጥረት እየጨመረ በመምጣቱ እና የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነቶች ባለመሳካታቸው ፓኪስታን የሁለቱን አገራት ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ንግግሮች ለማደስ ጥረቷን አጠናክራ ቀጥላለች። የፓኪስታን ባለስልጣናት ለኢራን ከፍተኛ አመራሮች ወደ እስላማባድ በመምጣት ስለሰላማዊ መፍትሄ እንዲወያዩ ግብዣ አቅርበዋል። ምንም እንኳን ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ ማስፈራሪያዎችን ቢሰነዝሩ እና ኢራን ቀጥተኛ ውይይት እንደሌለ ብትገልጽም፣ ፓኪስታን ግጭቱን ለመፍታት ቁልፍ አስታራቂ ሀገር ሆና ለመቀጠል ትጥራለች።
oromo: Itti fufinsa walitti bu'iinsa fi kutaannoo tasgabbii dhabuu jiddu galeessa godhachuun, Paakistaan hariiroo fi marii Ameerikaa fi Iraan gidduu jiru haaromsuuf carraaqqii gama dippiloomasii gochaa jirti. Mootummaan Paakistaan hoogganoota Iraan gama marii nagaatiin akka isaan waliin haasa'an afeerraa dhiyeessiteetti. Prezidaanti Traamp akeekkachiisa cimaa kennanii fi Iraan marii kallattii tokko illee akka hin goone ibsituus, Paakistaan rakkoo kana furuuf gahee araarsummaa ishee bahuuf murteessiteetti.

title: Israel suffers record emigration wave, with almost 270,000 leaving since 2023
english: A recent study from Tel Aviv University reveals that Israel is experiencing its largest wave of emigration in history, with nearly 270,000 citizens leaving the country since 2023. Researchers noted that the departure of many skilled professionals, such as doctors and engineers, creates a significant risk for the nation’s future economy and security. Experts warn that if this trend continues to grow, it could become a self-sustaining cycle that is increasingly difficult to reverse.
amharic: የቴል አቪቭ ዩኒቨርሲቲ ጥናት እንደሚያሳየው እስራኤል ከ2023 ጀምሮ በታሪኳ ከፍተኛውን የዜጎች ስደት አስተናግዳለች፤ በዚህም ወደ 270,000 የሚጠጉ ሰዎች ሀገሪቱን ለቀው ወጥተዋል። በርካታ የሰለጠኑ ባለሙያዎች በተለይም የሕክምና እና የቴክኒክ ባለሙያዎች መሰደዳቸው ለሀገሪቱ ኢኮኖሚ እና ደህንነት ከፍተኛ ስጋት ደቅኗል። ይህ የሰዎች መውጣት ሂደት ካልተገታ፣ ወደፊት ለመመለስ አስቸጋሪ የሆነ የሰንሰለት ምላሽ ሊፈጥር እንደሚችል ተመራማሪዎች ያስጠነቅቃሉ።
oromo: Qorannoon Yuunivarsiitii Tel Aviv akka agarsiisutti, Israa'el bara 2023 irraa eegalee godaansa lammiilee ishee seenaa keessatti mul'atee hin beekne keessa dabarsaa jirti; namoonni 270,000 ol ta'an biyyattii gadi lakkisanii bahaniiru. Ogeeyyiin hojii adda addaa, keessattuu ogeeyyii fayyaa fi injineeronni biyya gadhiisuun isaanii dinagdee fi nageenya biyyattii irratti balaa guddaa qaba. Qorattoonni akka ibsanitti, adeemsi kun yoo itti fufe, jijjiiruun isaa gara fuulduraatti baay'ee ulfaataa ta'uu danda'a.

title: Board of Peace caves to Netanyahu and rewrites Israeli withdrawal terms from Gaza
english: The U.S.-supported Board of Peace has adjusted its Gaza withdrawal plan following discussions with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. The board now mandates that all Hamas weaponry and tunnels must be fully neutralized before Israeli forces retreat past the Yellow Line. This decision replaces the previous gradual withdrawal strategy, effectively hardening the requirements for ending the military occupation.
amharic: በአሜሪካ ድጋፍ የሚንቀሳቀሰው የሰላም ቦርድ ከጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ ጋር ከተወያየ በኋላ ከጋዛ የመውጣት እቅዱን ቀይሯል። ቦርዱ አሁን እስራኤል ከጫፍ መስመሩ (Yellow Line) ባሻገር ከመውጣቷ በፊት ሀማስ ሁሉንም የጦር መሳሪያዎች እና ዋሻዎች ማስወገድ እንዳለበት ወስኗል። ይህ አዲስ መመሪያ ቀደም ሲል የታቀደውን ደረጃ በደረጃ የመውጣት ስትራቴጂ የሚቀይር እና የውትድርና መውጣቱን ሁኔታ የሚያከብድ ነው።
oromo: Boordiin Nageenyaa kan deeggarsa Amerikaa qabu, marii ministira muummee Binyamiin Neetanyaahuu waliin taasiseen booda karoora gadi dhiisuu qarqara Gaazaa jijjiireera. Boordichi amma kan murteesse, humnoonni Israa'el sarara 'Yellow Line' jedhamu darbuun dura, gareen Hamaas meeshaalee waraanaa fi godoo isaa hunda guutummaatti hiikuu akka qabanidha. Murteen kun karoora duraan ture kan sadarkaa sadarkaan ba'uu ture san haquun, haala waraana keessaa ba'uu sana akka jabaatu taasiseera.

title: US has used 'virtually all' of its long-range precision missiles during Iran war, say sources
english: Following five months of conflict with Iran, the United States has depleted nearly its entire inventory of long-range surface-to-surface precision missiles. Reports indicate that the military has utilized almost all of its ATACMS and about half of its global supply of Tomahawk missiles. This significant consumption has forced the U.S. Central Command to pull resources from other global regions to maintain their operational capabilities.
amharic: ከኢራን ጋር ለተካሄደው የአምስት ወር ጦርነት ተከትሎ፣ አሜሪካ እጅግ ዘመናዊ የሆኑ የረጅም ርቀት ሚሳይል ክምችቷን በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ ተጠቅማለች። መረጃዎች እንደሚያመለክቱት፣ አገሪቱ አብዛኛውን የመሬት-ለ-መሬት ሚሳይሎቿን እና ግማሽ ያህሉን የቶማሃውክ ሚሳይል ክምችቷን ተጠቅማ ጨርሳለች። በዚህም ሳቢያ የአሜሪካ ማዕከላዊ ዕዝ ወታደራዊ አቅሙን ለማስቀጠል ከሌሎች የዓለም ክፍሎች የጦር መሣሪያዎችን ለማዛወር ተገዷል።
oromo: Amerikaa waraana ji'a shanfiruuf Iran waliin taasisteen, meeshaalee waraanaa fageenya dheeraa rukutan kanneen of-eeggannoon qophaa'an hedduu fixatteetti. Maddi odeeffannoo akka ibsetti, meeshaaleen ATACMS jedhaman guutummaatti xumuramaniiru, akkasumas meeshaaleen Tomahawk jedhaman harki walakkaan isaanii fayyadamamaniiru. Rakkoo kana hiikuuf, ajajni waraana Amerikaa kan giddu galaa, meeshaalee kana bakka biroo addunyaarraa gara naannichaa fiduuf dirqameera.

title: Board of Peace caves to Netanyahu and rewrites Israeli withdrawal terms from Gaza
english: The U.S.-supported Board of Peace has adjusted its Gaza withdrawal strategy to align with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s demands. It now requires the total disarmament of Hamas before any Israeli forces retreat from their current positions, moving away from its previous proposal for a gradual, phased withdrawal. This shift has raised concerns that the peace process may be stalled, as it contradicts earlier agreements and allows Israel to maintain its military presence and offensive operations.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ድጋፍ ያለው የሰላም ቦርድ የጋዛን ለቀው የመውጣት ስትራቴጂውን ከጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ ፍላጎት ጋር በማጣጣም ቀይሮታል። ቦርዱ ቀደም ሲል የነበረውን የደረጃ በደረጃ የመውጣት እቅድ በመተው፣ የእስራኤል ጦር ከያዘው ቦታ ከመውጣቱ በፊት የሃማስ ታጣቂዎች ሙሉ በሙሉ ትጥቅ መፍታት አለባቸው የሚል አቋም ይዟል። ይህ ለውጥ ከቀድሞው ስምምነት ጋር የሚጋጭ በመሆኑ እና እስራኤል ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴዋን እንድትቀጥል ስለሚፈቅድ የሰላም ሂደቱን አደጋ ላይ ሊጥል እንደሚችል ተገልጿል።
oromo: Boordiin nageenyaa kan Ameerikaan deggeramu, tarsiimoo isaa kan gadi lhiquu Gaaza irraa dhufe irratti jijjiirama gochuun fedhii muummee ministiraa Benjaamin Netaaniyaahuu hordofuu jalqabeera. Kanaan dura sagantaa sadarkaa sadarkaan gadi lhiquu ture dhiisuun, waraanni Israa'eel bakka amma irra jiru gadhiisee bahuu dura, gareen Hamaas hidhannoosaa guutummaatti hiikkachuu qaba jedhee jira. Jijjiiramni kun kutaalee dura waliigalamanii turan wajjin kan wal-faallessuufi Israa'eel humna waraanaashee akkasumas haleellaashee akka itti fuftu kan hayyamu waan ta'eef, adeemsi nageenyaa sun dhiphachuu akka danda'u ibsameera.

title: US-Saudi strikes test Iraq's balancing act between Riyadh and Tehran
english: Recent joint air strikes by the United States and Saudi Arabia against Iran-affiliated militias in Iraq have complicated the Iraqi government’s efforts to maintain neutral relations with regional powers. These attacks were a direct response to drone strikes on Saudi oil infrastructure and serve as a warning to Tehran regarding its influence in the region. While both the militias and Saudi Arabia have indicated they prefer to avoid an ongoing conflict, the Iraqi government now faces immense pressure to manage its internal security while navigating these delicate diplomatic tensions.
amharic: በኢራቅ የሚገኙ ከኢራን ጋር ግንኙነት ያላቸው ታጣቂ ቡድኖች ላይ በአሜሪካ እና በሳውዲ አረቢያ በጋራ የተፈጸመው የአየር ጥቃት የኢራቅን መንግስት የውጭ ግንኙነት ሚዛን ጠብቆ ለመጓዝ የሚያደርገውን ጥረት ፈታኝ አድርጎታል። ይህ ጥቃት በሳውዲ የነዳጅ ማዕከላት ላይ ለተፈጸመው የድሮን ጥቃት ምላሽ የነበረ ሲሆን ለኢራን ጠንካራ ማስጠንቀቂያ ለመስጠት ያለመ ነው። ምንም እንኳን ሁለቱም ወገኖች ግጭቱን ለማስፋት ፍላጎት ባይኖራቸውም፣ ኢራቅ አሁን በአገሪቱ ውስጥ ካሉ ታጣቂ ቡድኖች ጋር ባላት ውስብስብ ግንኙነት እና በክልሉ አገራት መካከል ያለውን ውጥረት ለማርገብ ከፍተኛ ጫና ውስጥ ወድቃለች።
oromo: Humni waraana Ameerikaafi Saudii Arabiyaa waliin ta'uun garee biyya Iraan deggeru kan Iraaq keessa jiran irratti haleellaa raawwataniin, mootummaan Iraaq hariiroo isaa kan biyyoota ollaa wajjin jiru madaaluuf yaaluu isaa kan ulfeesse ta'eera. Haleellaan kun kan raawwatame dhaabbata boba'aa Saudii irratti haleellaa xiyyaaraa kanaan dura raawwatameef deebii kennuufi akkasumas biyya Iraan akeekkachiisuufi. Garuunni sunis ta'e Saudii Arabiyaan walitti bu'iinsa bal'aa irraa of qusachuuf kan yaalan ta'us, mootummaan Iraaq amma nageenya biyya keessaa eeggachuufi hariiroo dippilomaasii kana madaaluuf rakkoo guddaa keessa galeera.

title: More than 150 migrants rescued after boat catches fire in Channel
english: Over 150 migrants were rescued on Tuesday after their boat caught fire while attempting to cross the English Channel to the UK. Although the passengers initially refused help from French authorities overnight, emergency teams from both France and Britain intervened once the vessel's condition worsened. Fortunately, all 157 individuals were safely recovered and are being transported to a port in France, with no casualties reported.
amharic: ከ150 በላይ ስደተኞች ወደ እንግሊዝ በጀልባ ሲሻገሩ ሳለ የያዙት ጀልባ በእሳት በመያዙ ምክንያት ማክሰኞ ዕለት ታድገዋል። ስደተኞቹ መጀመሪያ ላይ የፈረንሳይ ባለስልጣናት ያቀረቡትን የእርዳታ ጥሪ አልቀበልም ቢሉም፣ ጀልባዋ በአደጋ ላይ ስትወድቅ የፈረንሳይ እና የብሪታንያ የነፍስ አድን ቡድኖች ጣልቃ በመግባት አድነዋቸዋል። በድምሩ 157 ሰዎች ከጉዳት በደህና መትረፋቸው የተረጋገጠ ሲሆን፣ በአሁኑ ሰዓት ሁሉም ወደ ፈረንሳይ ወደብ እየተወሰዱ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Namoonni godaantota ta'an 150 ol ta'an, doonii gara UK deemutti jirtu keessatti ibidda ka'een booda Kibxata ganama oolaniiru. Godaantonni kun yeroo jalqabaa gargaarsa humnoota Faransaayi dhiyeessan fudhachuu didanii kan turan ta'us, doonittiin erga miidhamtee booda gareen fayyisaa Faransaayiifi Biritaaniyaa harka galchuun isaan oolchuuf dirqamaniiru. Namoonni 157 kun hundi miidhaan irra osoo hin ga'in nageenyaan kan fayyan yoo ta'u, amma gara buufata Faransaayiitti geessamaa jiru.

title: What will happen when a SpaceX rocket collides with the Moon?
english: A discarded upper stage of a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket is expected to crash into the Moon's surface this Wednesday. Experts confirm the event poses no threat to Earth and will likely create a new crater over 17 meters wide near the Einstein Crater. Scientists view this collision as a unique research opportunity to study the impact site, adding to the Moon's long history of crater formation.
amharic: የስፔስ ኤክስ ፋልኮን 9 ሮኬት ክፍል በሆነው አንድ ቁራጭ በዚህ ረቡዕ ጨረቃ ላይ እንደሚጋጭ ተገምቷል። ሳይንቲስቶች ይህ ክስተት በምድር ላይ ምንም አይነት አደጋ እንደማይፈጥር እና በአይንስታይን ክሬተር አቅራቢያ ከ17 ሜትር በላይ ስፋት ያለው ጉድጓድ እንደሚፈጥር ገልጸዋል። ባለሙያዎች ይህንን ግጭት ጨረቃን በቅርበት ለመመልከት እና ተፅእኖዋን ለማጥናት እንደ ጥሩ አጋጣሚ እየተመለከቱት ነው።
oromo: Kutaan rookeetii SpaceX Falcon 9 kan duraan gadi dhiifame tokko roobi dhufu kana gara ji'atti akka gatu eegama. Ogeeyyonni akka jedhanitti, taateen kun lafarra balaa kan hin geessisne yoo ta'u, naannoo Einstein Crater jedhamutti boolla bal'ina meetira 17 ol ta'e akka uumu ibsameera. Saayintistoonni walitti bu'iinsa kana akka carraa gaarii tokkootti ilaaluun, lafa ji'aa irratti jijjiirama uumamu qorachuuf itti fayyadamu.

title: Why Trump Media's sale of fast access to market-moving social posts is controversial
english: Trump Media has introduced a paid service called Truth API that offers financial firms ultra-fast access to influential social media posts on Truth Social. By allowing traders to react to market-moving statements in milliseconds, the company aims to generate revenue for its struggling business. This decision has sparked significant debate regarding ethics and potential conflicts of interest, as the former president holds a majority stake in the company profiting from his own public comments.
amharic: ትራምፕ ሚዲያ 'ትሩዝ ኤፒአይ' የተባለ አዲስ የክፍያ አገልግሎት የጀመረ ሲሆን ይህም የፋይናንስ ተቋማት በትሩዝ ሶሻል ላይ የሚለቀቁ ተፅዕኖ ፈጣሪ መረጃዎችን እጅግ በፍጥነት እንዲያገኙ የሚያስችል ነው። ኩባንያው ገቢ ለማግኘት ያለመ ቢሆንም፣ የቀድሞው ፕሬዚዳንት በኩባንያው ውስጥ ከፍተኛ ድርሻ እያላቸው በራሳቸው ንግግሮች ገንዘብ ማግኘታቸው የስነ-ምግባር ጥያቄዎችን አስነስቷል። ተገበያዮች እነዚህን መረጃዎች በሰከንዶች ውስጥ በመጠቀም የገበያ እንቅስቃሴን ለመቆጣጠር ስለሚጠቀሙበት፣ ጉዳዩ የህግ እና የፍትሃዊነት ክርክሮችን እየጋበዘ ይገኛል።
oromo: Trump Media tajaajila kaffaltii qabu kan 'Truth API' jedhamu kan eegale yoo ta'u, kunis dhaabbilee faayinaansii fi daldaltootaaf oduuwwan gurguddoo Truth Social irra jiran saffisaan argachuu dandeessisa. Tajaajilli kun dhaabbata faayidaa argachuu dadhabeef galii argamsiisuuf kan yaadame yoo ta'u, garuu gochi kun gaaffiiwwan amala gaarii fi walitti bu'iinsa faayidaa kaaseera. Sababni isaas, dura ta'aan kun qooda guddaa qabaachuu isaatiin ibsa ofii isaatiin gabaa irratti dhiibbaa uumee akka fayyadamu waan ta'eef, kunis seeraa fi haqa irratti mormii guddaa uumee jira.

title: Why Israel’s economy hasn’t collapsed during a multi-front war
english: Despite being involved in an ongoing multi-front war, Israel’s economy has remained remarkably resilient. The nation has successfully continued to draw significant foreign investments while maintaining the stability and strength of its currency. This economic endurance has surprised many observers given the high costs and disruptions typically associated with prolonged military conflicts.
amharic: እስራኤል በበርካታ ግንባሮች ጦርነት ውስጥ ብትሆንም፣ ኢኮኖሚዋ ግን ሳይናወጥ መቀጠሉ አስገራሚ ሆኗል። አገሪቱ ከፍተኛ መጠን ያለው የውጭ ኢንቨስትመንት መሳብ የቻለች ሲሆን የገንዘቧም ዋጋ ጠንካራ ሆኖ መቆየቱን ችላለች። ይህም ረጅም ጊዜ የሚፈጅ ጦርነት የሚያስከትለውን የኢኮኖሚ ቀውስ በመቋቋም በብዙዎች ዘንድ ትኩረትን ስቧል።
oromo: Israa'el gammoojjii hedduu keessatti waraana irratti bobbaatee kan jirtu ta'us, diinagdeen ishee garuu hin kufne. Biyyi kun invastimantii alaa hedduu harkisuu fi gatiin maallaqa ishee cimaa ta'ee akka itti fufu taasisuu dandeesseetti. Kunuun diinagdee kun waraana dheeraa fi rakkoolee diinagdee walitti fufan akka malee dammamee mul'atuun namoota hedduu dinqisiiseera.

title: Misread as passive, the Gulf is quietly ending fifty years of dependence
english: The recent conflict between Iran and the Gulf nations has highlighted that relying on outside security guarantees is no longer sustainable. Instead of seeking another foreign security umbrella, Gulf states are shifting toward building their own internal defense systems to ensure regional stability. This move represents a strategic effort to move away from fifty years of dependency and secure vital infrastructure against ongoing regional threats.
amharic: በኢራን እና በባህረ ሰላጤው አገራት መካከል የተፈጠረው የቅርብ ጊዜ ግጭት፣ በውጭ ኃይሎች የደህንነት ዋስትና ላይ መተማመን እንደማያዋጣ አሳይቷል። የባህረ ሰላጤው አገራት በሌላ የውጭ ጥበቃ ከመታመን ይልቅ፣ የክልሉን ሰላም ለማስጠበቅ የራሳቸውን የመከላከያ አቅም ለመገንባት እየተንቀሳቀሱ ነው። ይህ እርምጃ አገራቱ ላለፉት ሃምሳ ዓመታት ሲከተሉት የነበረውን ጥገኝነት በማስወገድ፣ ወሳኝ መሠረተ ልማቶቻቸውን ከክልላዊ ስጋቶች ለመከላከል ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Gurgurtoowwan Iran fi biyyoota Gulf gidduutti uumame akka mirkaneessetti, nageenya ofii eeggachuuf humnoota alaa irratti hirkachuun furmaata miti. Biyyoonni Gulf kun gargaarsa humna alaa biraa barbaaduu mannaa, nageenya naannoo isaanii mirkaneessuuf sirna ittisaa mataa isaanii ijaarrachuu jalqabaniiru. Tarkaanfin kun waggoota shantama darban keessa turan hirkattummaa xiqqeessuufi bu'uuraalee misoomaa isaanii sodaalee naannoo irraa ittisuuf kan karoorfame dha.

title: Who is behind settler violence in the occupied West Bank?
english: Extremist settler groups in the occupied West Bank are intensifying attacks against Palestinians to seize land and force residents out. Guided by hard-line nationalist and religious ideologies, these groups work to expand illegal settlements and prevent any future political peace processes. They operate with support from political and legal networks that allow them to use settlement outposts as bases for their violent activities.
amharic: በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ አካባቢ የሚንቀሳቀሱ የጽንፈኛ ሰፋሪዎች ቡድን መሬትን ለመቆጣጠር እና ፍልስጤማውያንን ለመፈናቀል በየጊዜው ጥቃት እየፈጸሙ ይገኛሉ። እነዚህ ቡድኖች በጠንካራ ሃይማኖታዊ እና ብሔርተኛ አስተሳሰብ በመመራት ህገ-ወጥ ሰፈራዎችን ለማስፋፋት እና ማንኛውንም የሰላም ሂደት ለማደናቀፍ ይሰራሉ። እንቅስቃሴያቸውም በፖለቲካዊ እና ህጋዊ ድጋፍ የተደገፈ በመሆኑ፣ ሰፈራዎቹን ለጥቃት መነሻነት እንዲጠቀሙበት እድል ሰጥቷቸዋል።
oromo: Gareen gahuudotaa fiixa-biraa kanneen naannoo weerarame West Bank keessatti argaman, lafa qabachuu fi Palestinoota buqqisuuf jecha weerara irratti raawwachaa jiru. Gareen kun ilaalcha amantii fi biyyaalessummaa cimaa hordofaa, babal'ina qophiiwwan seeraan alaa fi adeemsa nagaa kamiyyuu gufachiisuuf hojjatu. Hojiin isaanii kun deeggarsa siyaasaa fi seeraa waan qabuuf, qophiiwwan isaan ijaaran kunneen akka buufata weeraraatti fayyadamuuf isaan gargaaraa jira.

title: ‘One last chance’: The times Trump threatened Iran, said deal imminent
english: US President Donald Trump has repeatedly threatened Iran with military action while simultaneously claiming a peace deal is imminent. Despite setting strict deadlines and issuing dire warnings, Trump has consistently backed down from these threats at the last minute. Meanwhile, Iran denies engaging in direct negotiations with the US, leaving the ongoing conflict unresolved after 23 weeks.
amharic: የአሜሪካው ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ኢራንን በወታደራዊ እርምጃ በተደጋጋሚ በማስፈራራት የሰላም ስምምነት ሊደረግ እንደሚችል በተደጋጋሚ ሲናገሩ ቆይተዋል። ትራምፕ ግልጽ የጊዜ ገደቦችን አስቀምጠው ከባድ ማስጠንቀቂያዎችን ቢሰጡም፣ በየጊዜው በወሰዷቸው እርምጃዎች ከመጨረሻው ሰዓት ላይ ከማስፈራሪያቸው ወደ ኋላ ሲሉ ታይተዋል። በሌላ በኩል ኢራን ከአሜሪካ ጋር ቀጥተኛ ድርድር እንደሌላት በመግለጿ፣ ላለፉት 23 ሳምንታት የዘለቀው ግጭት አሁንም መፍትሄ ሳይበጅለት ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Pirezedantiin Ameerikaa Doonaald Tiraamp Iran irratti tarkaanfii waraanaa fudhachuu sodaachisaa akkasumas waliigalteen nageenyaa dhihoo akka jiru irra deddeebi'anii ibsaa turaniiru. Tiraamp yeroo murtaa'aa kaa'uun akeekkachiisa cimaa kennanis, daqiiqaa dhumaarratti yaada isaanii jijjiiruun sodaachisa isaanii irraa duubatti jedhu. Gama biraatiin, Iran Ameerikaa waliin marii kallattii hin qabnu jechuun waan haalteef, waraanni torbee 23f itti fufe kun furmaata utuu hin argatin itti fufeera.

title: Italy suspends free movement with Spain: Is Schengen in crisis after Ceuta?
english: Italy has temporarily reinstated border controls for travelers arriving from Spain following a massive influx of migrants into the Spanish enclave of Ceuta. Experts clarify that Italy is not exiting the Schengen Agreement, but is instead using a common legal provision that allows member states to implement temporary checks. This decision is seen largely as a political move, as Italy and Spain do not share a land border, meaning the impact on travel is limited to air and sea routes.

oromo: Xaliyaan baqattoota miliyoonatti lakkaa'aman gara lafa Speen kan taate Se'uutatti seenuun hordofee, namoota Speen irraa gara Xaliyaan deeman irratti to'annoo daangaa yeroo kaa'uuf murteessiteetti. Ogeeyyiin akka jedhanitti, tarkaanfiin kun walii galtee Sheengen kan cabsu utuu hin taane, biyyoonni miseensa ta'an yeroo barbaachisaa ta'eetti itti fayyadamuu kan danda'an mirga seera qabeessa dha. Xaliyaan fi Speen daangaa lafaa walitti hin qabne waan ta'eef, murteen kun qilleensaan fi galaanaan imaltuu irratti kan daangeffameefi akka tarkaanfii siyaasaatti kan ilaalamu dha.

title: Lebanon and Israel hold new round of direct talks in Rome
english: Lebanese and Israeli officials have met in Rome for another series of US-mediated discussions regarding the withdrawal of Israeli forces from southern Lebanon. These talks build on a prior framework that proposed replacing militants with the Lebanese national army, a plan previously opposed by Hezbollah. Despite the ongoing negotiations, Hezbollah leadership has publicly dismissed these efforts as harmful to the nation's interests.
amharic: የሊባኖስ እና የእስራኤል ባለስልጣናት የእስራኤል ወታደሮች ከደቡብ ሊባኖስ እንዲወጡ በዩናይትድ ስቴትስ አደራዳሪነት በሮም ተገናኝተዋል። እነዚህ ድርድሮች ቀደም ሲል የቀረበውን የሊባኖስ ብሄራዊ ጦር በደቡባዊ አካባቢዎች እንዲሰማራ የሚያደርግ እቅድ መሰረት ያደረጉ ናቸው። ሆኖም፣ የሂዝቦላህ አመራሮች እነዚህን ድርድሮች ሀገሪቱን የሚጎዱ እና ውርደትን የሚያስከትሉ ናቸው ሲሉ ተቃውመዋል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni Libaanoos fi Israa'el loltoonni Israa'el kibba Libaanoos irraa akka bahaniif marii Ameerikaan giddu galeessa taateen Roomitti jalqabaniiru. Mariin kun kanaan dura qophii loltoota biyyoolessa Libaanoos naannichatti bobbaasuuf karoorfamee ture irratti hundaa'a. Haa ta'u malee, hogganoonni Hizbullaah mariin kun biyyattii irratti miidhaa fi salphina kan fidu ta'uu ibsuun mormaniiru.

title: How Morocco's Gaza deployment is reshaping its ties with Israel
english: Morocco has become the first Arab and African nation to send military personnel to the International Stabilisation Force in Gaza as part of a U.S.-led peace initiative. By deploying 200 soldiers, the Moroccan government aims to strengthen its diplomatic influence in the region and fulfill its duties under the Board of Peace. However, the mission faces significant uncertainty as Israel continues to expand its settlements and has not agreed to a withdrawal timeline, despite the move being framed by Rabat as a commitment to peace and humanitarian aid.
amharic: ሞሮኮ በአሜሪካ የሚመራው የሰላም ዕቅድ አካል በመሆን ወደ ጋዛ የሰላም አስከባሪ ወታደሮችን የላከች የመጀመሪያው የአረብ እና የአፍሪካ ሀገር ሆናለች። የሞሮኮ መንግስት 200 ወታደሮችን በመላክ በክልሉ ያለውን ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ተጽዕኖ ለማጠናከር እና የሰላም ቦርድ አባልነቱን ግዴታ ለመወጣት ያለመ ቢሆንም፣ እስራኤል ህገ-ወጥ ሰፈራዋን እያስፋፋች በመሆኑ የዚህ ተልዕኮ ውጤታማነት አጠያያቂ ሆኗል። ራባት ይህን እርምጃ ለሰላም እና ለሰብአዊ ድጋፍ የገባችው ቃል እንደሆነ ብትገልጽም፣ እስራኤል ከጋዛ የመውጣት እቅድ አለማሳየቷ ሁኔታውን አወሳስቦታል።
oromo: Morookoon sagantaa nagaa kan Ameerikaan hoogganamu keessatti hirmaachuun, waraana ishee gara Gaazaatti erguun biyya Arabaa fi Afrikaa jalqabaa taateetti. Mootummaan Morookoo waraana 200 erguun isaa dhiibbaa diippilomaasii isaa naannichatti cimsachuu fi dirqama 'Boordii Nagaa' (Board of Peace) keessatti qabu bahuuf kan karoorfame ta'us, Israa'el qubsuma seera-malee babal'isuu ishee fi iddoo sanaa gadi lakkisuuf fedhii waan hin argisiifneef, ergichi bu'aa qabaachuu isaa shakkiin keessa galeera. Raabaatin tarkaanfii kana nagaa fi gargaarsa namoomaaf akka ta'e ibsituus, Israa'el dhiisuuf waadaa hin galin jiruun haalli kun rakkoo cimaa keessa jira.

title: Video: Israeli settlers attack homes and burn cars in West Bank
english: Israeli settlers recently invaded the Palestinian villages of Talfit and Jalud, situated in the southern Nablus region of the West Bank. During the raid, they set fire to three vehicles and caused damage to several residential homes. Local sources reported these violent attacks as part of ongoing tensions in the occupied territory.
amharic: የእስራኤል ሰፈራ ነዋሪዎች በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ ናብሉስ ግዛት በሚገኙት ታሊፊት እና ጃሉድ በተባሉ የፍልስጤም መንደሮች ላይ ጥቃት ፈጽመዋል። በዚሁ ጥቃት ወቅት ሶስት ተሽከርካሪዎችን በእሳት ያቃጠሉ ሲሆን የመኖሪያ ቤቶች ላይም ጉዳት አድርሰዋል። ይህ ክስተት በክልሉ እየተባባሰ የመጣውን የጸጥታ መደፍረስ የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Buqqaattoonni Israa'el naannoo Qarxii (West Bank) keessatti, baadiyyaa Falasxiin kan ta'an Talfiit fi Jaaluud irratti weerara gaggeessaniiru. Weerara kanaan konkolaattoota sadii gubanii, manneen jireenyaa irrattis miidhaa geessisaniiru. Gochi kun walitti bu'iinsa naannichatti hammaataa jiru kan ibsuudha.

title: Qatar says US-Iran talks are 'ongoing'
english: Qatar has announced that diplomatic efforts to mediate between the United States and Iran are continuing despite conflicting reports. While President Trump mentioned that discussions are currently active, Iranian officials have denied any scheduled meetings. Qatar remains focused on encouraging both nations to return to the negotiating table to find a peaceful resolution.
amharic: በአሜሪካ እና በኢራን መካከል ያለው የዲፕሎማሲያዊ ግንኙነት ግራ የሚያጋባ ቢሆንም፣ ሂደቱ አሁንም መቀጠሉን ኳታር አስታውቃለች። ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ ንግግሮች እየተካሄዱ መሆናቸውን ቢናገሩም፣ የኢራን ባለስልጣናት ግን ምንም አይነት ቀጠሮ እንደሌለ ገልጸዋል። ኳታር በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ሰላማዊ መፍትሄ ለማምጣት ንግግሩ እንዲቀጥል ጥረቷን አጠናክራ ቀጥላለች።
oromo: Qatar, haasaa fi mariin gidduu Ameerikaa fi Iraan jiru akka itti fufuuf carraaqqii gochaa akka jirtu beeksisiteetti. Preezidaantiin Ameerikaa mariin akka jiru dubbatanis, mootummaan Iraan garuu mariin kamiyyuu akka hin jirre ibseera. Qatar waldhabdee kana furuuf gamtaan lameen gara mariitti akka deebi'an jajjabeessaa jirti.
